questions.q: What does Goggins mean by the 40% rule?
a: We quit at 40% of our capacity and have more to give
We should train only 40% of the time
Forty percent of success comes from talent
We should rest after 40 minutes of work
questions.why: Lesson 3 says people surrender after using only 40% of their maximum power, leaving most of their ability untapped.

questions.q: What did Goggins do after seeing a documentary about the Navy SEALs?
a: Lost 109 pounds in three months to qualify
Joined the Air Force instead
Started a fitness YouTube channel
Began training for a marathon
questions.why: Lesson 1 describes him shedding 109 pounds in three months, well past the weight limit for SEAL training.

questions.q: How does Goggins suggest you handle a bad hand in life?
a: Look for the advantages the difficulty gives you
Focus on what you would change about it
Wait until conditions improve before acting
Talk it through with a professional
questions.why: Lesson 1 says hardships build strength, like lifting weights, so you should mine them for what they give you.

questions.q: What does Goggins call the part of the mind that sets limits and fears risk?
a: The governor
The compass
The anchor
The critic
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes the governor as the mental mechanism that knows your limits and feeds on insecurity.

questions.q: When does Goggins say victory is often decided?
a: When you give your best while feeling your worst
When you are rested and fully prepared
When your opponent is caught unprepared
When you have a clear written plan
questions.why: Lesson 2 quotes Goggins saying victory comes down to bringing your very best when you feel your worst.
